answer: Whisper relay blocks bulk fakes. Each agent strikes a key-signed whisper at its forge and sends it through three relays, each hop stamping it for a rising fee. A prism splits it into key, timing, and counterpart facets; mismatch burns the 70-credit bond. First 45, k-th 45+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,042,000 plus 70,000 locked vs a 40,000 pool. Rented relays fail: the prism shows borrowed timing. Honest agents pay 45 once for full nectar shares.
